subject: Literature
subcategory: Classic Novels That Changed the World
title: The Handmaid's Tale and Political Warning
description: A 60-second lesson on The Handmaid's Tale and Political Warning.

hook.text: Margaret Atwood wrote a dystopia where women were stripped of all rights overnight in a modern democracy.

buildup.text: The Handmaid's Tale described a theocracy that enslaved women as breeding property for powerful men.

discovery.text: Published in 1985, Atwood insisted every horror in the book had already happened somewhere in history.

twist.text: Decades later, the red handmaid robes became real-world protest symbols used by women's rights activists.

climax.text: The novel proved that fiction can become a political toolkit, not just a mirror, but a weapon for change.

punchline.text: A fictional costume became a real protest uniform.

quiz.question: What did Margaret Atwood say about the events in The Handmaid's Tale?
options: Every horror in the book had already happened somewhere in history
